ranked_version_space.hypothesis: The immediate frontier is improving which already-available SAIR motifs/reasons are selected and scheduled, building on clean motif scheduling, persistent Reason Atlas scale evaluation, and spectral H-Tilt.
ranked_version_space.required_evidence: Matched candidate-generation runs should change success/search cost when only scheduling or priority changes.
ranked_version_space.separator: Freeze the candidate/operator pool and budget; compare current scheduler against an alternative priority/tilt policy on the same residual set.
ranked_version_space.promote_if: routing/scheduling changes alter reachability or cost without introducing a new operator/representation family.

ranked_version_space.hypothesis: The loop is ready to make Reason-Atlas structure condition root-operator/constructor induction, so failures change what solving machinery is generated rather than only what is scheduled.
ranked_version_space.required_evidence: A residual/Reason-Atlas-conditioned constructor must create reachability unavailable to the frozen existing operator pool.
ranked_version_space.separator: Freeze routing and budget; compare generic root-operator induction with Reason-Atlas-conditioned construction on the same unresolved residuals.
ranked_version_space.promote_if: conditioned construction produces a new verified operator/schema family and targeted ablation restores failure.

ranked_version_space.hypothesis: The next gain comes from making the persistent Reason Atlas compound across source-distinct SAIR episodes rather than from another local scheduler or constructor change.
ranked_version_space.required_evidence: Warm persistent state should outperform cold replay on held-out episodes under matched search and operator language.
ranked_version_space.separator: Run source-held-out warm-versus-cold episodes with identical solver/search budgets and no new operator family.
ranked_version_space.promote_if: persistent cross-episode state causally reduces search or creates later reachability, with ablation removing the gain.

ranked_version_space.hypothesis: The scheduler is exposing a representation bottleneck: the system needs a new quotient/continuation/relation-level abstraction that unifies motifs or evidence before further scheduling pays off.
ranked_version_space.required_evidence: A representation change should preserve semantics while changing cross-case reuse or reachability under matched routing.
ranked_version_space.separator: Hold scheduler and constructors fixed; introduce one candidate quotient/continuation abstraction and test transfer plus inverse ablation.
ranked_version_space.promote_if: the new representation transports capability or exposes a previously unavailable continuation without extra search budget.

ranked_version_space.hypothesis: The breakthrough loop still needs stronger closed-loop validation/promotion rather than a new solving regime.
ranked_version_space.required_evidence: Candidate capabilities already exist but fail trustworthy replay/admission or protected-behaviour gates.
ranked_version_space.separator: Replay the same candidate set through stricter admission/verification with solving machinery frozen.
ranked_version_space.promote_if: the dominant change is verification/trust/promotion reliability rather than new reachability machinery.

highest_information_separator.name: matched_four_arm_regime_separator
highest_information_separator.design: On one frozen residual pool and fixed total budget, run: A routing/scheduler-only change; B Reason-Atlas-conditioned construction with routing frozen; C warm persistent state with both routing and operator language frozen; D representation/quotient change with routing and constructors frozen. Keep a fifth replay/admission-only control. Score new reachability, search cost, transfer, and targeted ablation.
highest_information_separator.decision_rule: Promote the smallest arm that changes protected reachability or cost causally; preserve multiple hypotheses if more than one arm changes a distinct residual basin.

claim_boundary: Historical next-commit family coverage is only a proxy for whether the version-space controller preserved the eventual developmental direction; it is not proof that the proposed separator would have caused the historical breakthrough.
